content: Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ eneno꞉ ao imo꞉wo꞉ fanda sio꞉

Yosa꞉b e fo꞉g kagalowaki, kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ siwa꞉l amio꞉ ya꞉li hagalema꞉no꞉ dowabiki, ene nanog kalumo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kaluka꞉isale tambo ha꞉la꞉ya hamana꞉ki iliga꞉fo꞉ma,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ene ao i a꞉no꞉ko꞉ e o꞉lia꞉ dotabiki, Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ we neka꞉ a꞉la꞉liki ao imo꞉wo꞉ kalaba fanda wido꞉.
Yosa꞉b e a꞉la꞉bo꞉ wida꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e halale ya꞉labikiyo꞉, Isib kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ elo꞉ ya꞉lo꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉ sa꞉la꞉i aneyo꞉, Fa꞉lo꞉wa꞉ ayamilo꞉ sa꞉sen kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉lo꞉ dabu.
Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ ao imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne Yosa꞉bka꞉! Ni dowo꞉ o꞉saba?” a꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉ba꞉. Ko꞉sega ao iyo꞉ e hendele fanda ba꞉dakiyo꞉, iyo꞉ iliga꞉sa꞉ga꞉ tagilaki, towo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉ma꞉no꞉ dowo꞉.

A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Gio꞉ nelo꞉ wena mena.” Iyo꞉ ma꞉uwo꞉wa ha꞉na꞉ga꞉ dowabiki, eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne gili gao Yosa꞉b. Giliyo꞉ ne moleya꞉ kilili ko꞉lo꞉, a꞉na ilikiyo꞉ ne Isib hen wenamio꞉ a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ne wena kililia꞉ga꞉ iliga꞉fo꞉ a꞉la꞉bo꞉, giliyo꞉ go꞉no꞉n a꞉ma꞉la꞉yo꞉ mo꞉gadiaki, kele asula꞉so꞉bo! Mo꞉wo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleya꞉ mela꞉no꞉wo꞉ tili doma꞉kiyo꞉, Gode eyo꞉ ne tamin wena iliga꞉fo꞉.
Dona a꞉la꞉ us wenamio꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ mo꞉fa꞉la꞉ne ko꞉lo꞉, maiyo꞉wo꞉ alan dowab. Dona bila꞉fo꞉ nowo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowalikiyo꞉, molofa alan dowaki, egelo꞉ amio꞉ eyo꞉ mo꞉gelalikiyo꞉, ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ mo꞉dia꞉ib.
Gode eyo꞉ so꞉lo꞉ gilo꞉wo꞉ alan asuwa꞉fa꞉no꞉ a꞉lakiyo꞉, gio꞉ daneliabena꞉ki, Gode eyo꞉ ne wena tamina iliga꞉fo꞉.

A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ giliyo꞉ ne wenami iliga꞉fo꞉ma. Ko꞉sega Gode eyo꞉ ne wena iliga꞉tabiki mio꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Gode eyo꞉ ne Fa꞉lo꞉wa꞉ iya o꞉ngo꞉ ta꞉taki, Fa꞉lo꞉wa꞉ ayo꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Isib heno꞉ tambo nemo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉.

“A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ gio꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ bo꞉bo꞉ge ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, dolo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉bi, ‘Gi so꞉wa, Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ gemo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉saga꞉fo꞉, “Gode eyo꞉ ne Isib heno꞉ nemo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, giyo꞉ mo꞉amalaki, nelo꞉wa bo꞉e tigini ya꞉bi.
Gelo꞉, gi so꞉wayo꞉lo꞉, gi ma꞉muwo꞉lo꞉, no꞉ fofo꞉wo꞉lo꞉, gilo꞉ amilo꞉ a꞉lab a꞉no꞉ tambo nelo꞉ so꞉l aniba Gosen hen a꞉na mesa꞉ni ya꞉bi.

Gio꞉ hen a꞉na salikiyo꞉, niyo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉. Mo꞉wo꞉ dona bila꞉fo꞉ a꞉namilo꞉ ma꞉no꞉lo꞉ma dowakilo꞉ maiyo꞉ alan doma꞉ib a꞉no꞉ o꞉fa꞉la꞉doma꞉nigab ko꞉lo꞉, gelo꞉ gi so꞉lo꞉wo꞉lo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ gilo꞉ amilo꞉ a꞉lab a꞉no꞉ tambo maiyo꞉wo꞉ mo꞉doma꞉ki, niyo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉.” Giliyo꞉ domo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉bi.’”

Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ a꞉kudu sa꞉laki a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “O꞉go꞉ ginin siya꞉yo꞉ ne Yosa꞉bo꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉bo꞉ fanda ba꞉dab. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ naole Ba꞉nsamen gelo꞉ ne Yosa꞉bo꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉bo꞉ fanda ba꞉dab ko꞉lo꞉, gio꞉ ha꞉na꞉ga꞉yo꞉ ne Isib amilo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lowan kalu dowo꞉ a꞉no꞉lia꞉, gili siya꞉lo꞉ ba꞉dab a꞉no꞉ tambo domo꞉wo꞉ fanda sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, e bo꞉bo꞉ge wena tililia꞉ ya꞉bi.”
Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, aole Ba꞉nsameno꞉ fafula꞉fo꞉liki a꞉la꞉yo꞉ ya꞉fodo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ ao i nolo꞉lo꞉ mimilaki, a꞉na ya꞉fodo꞉. A꞉ma꞉ fa꞉s amio꞉ ao iyo꞉ Yosa꞉b o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ a꞉na tola꞉.

Fa꞉lo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ kaluka꞉isale ene ayamilo꞉ sa꞉sen i o꞉lia꞉ma꞉yo꞉, “Yosa꞉ba꞉ ene ao iyo꞉ mio꞉ka꞉” a꞉la꞉bo꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Fa꞉lo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ ene nanog kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉ mada sagalaki, Fa꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ Yosa꞉bo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Giyo꞉ gao imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉saga꞉ta꞉bi, ‘Giliyo꞉ we au dimidama. Gio꞉ kelego꞉lo꞉ dia꞉ha꞉na꞉no꞉ no꞉ a꞉no꞉ dimidalia꞉ga꞉, Ka꞉ina꞉n hen a꞉na a꞉ma꞉la꞉ ha꞉na꞉bi.

A꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, gili go꞉lo꞉lo꞉, gili so꞉lo꞉wo꞉lo꞉ nelo꞉ wena tililia꞉ga꞉ ya꞉bi. Gio꞉ wena fa꞉la꞉dowalikiyo꞉, niyo꞉ Isib hen wenamio꞉ hen nafale nowo꞉ gimo꞉ dimia꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, giliyo꞉ ma꞉no꞉ nafa hen wenamilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowa꞉sen a꞉no꞉ na꞉mela꞉ib.’

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Yosa꞉b giyo꞉ to welo꞉ a꞉la꞉saga꞉ta꞉bi. ‘Giliyo꞉ we au dimidama. Donkiya꞉lo꞉ i fofodo꞉ susululia꞉ ha꞉na꞉sen Isib hen wilo꞉ da꞉lab a꞉no꞉ giliyo꞉ nolo꞉ Ka꞉ina꞉n hen a꞉na dia꞉ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, gili so꞉wagalin o꞉lia꞉, ga o꞉lia꞉yo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ go꞉lo꞉lo꞉ iyo꞉ tambo i fofodo꞉ wa꞉l a꞉na kandaya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, a꞉ma꞉la꞉ ya꞉bi.

Isib hen amilo꞉ kelego꞉ nafale da꞉lab we niyo꞉ gimo꞉ dimia꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, kelego꞉ ginido꞉ Ka꞉ina꞉n hen a꞉namilo꞉ da꞉lab a꞉no꞉, giliyo꞉ ka ta꞉fo꞉ ya꞉bi.’ Giyo꞉ gao imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉bi” Fa꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

Fa꞉lo꞉ elo꞉ sio꞉ au, Isolaela꞉ insiso꞉ima꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉dimido꞉. Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ Fa꞉lo꞉wa꞉ towo꞉ kudu ha꞉naki, donkiya꞉lo꞉ i fofodo꞉ susululia꞉ ha꞉na꞉sen a꞉no꞉ imo꞉ dimia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, iyo꞉ toga ha꞉na꞉ga꞉ ha꞉nakilo꞉ ma꞉no꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ a꞉na dimi.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ eyo꞉ ao imo꞉wo꞉ helebeso꞉g ho꞉gi ka꞉ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ imilida꞉la꞉ sagalifa꞉. Ko꞉sega eyo꞉ silba mole 300 a꞉la꞉fo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ helebeso꞉g ho꞉gi ka꞉ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ bila꞉fo꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ Ba꞉nsamen emo꞉ dimi.

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ boba kelego꞉ iyamo꞉lo꞉ dimina꞉kilo꞉ iliga꞉fo꞉wo꞉ we. Isib hen amilo꞉ kelego꞉ nafaleyo꞉ donki do꞉la꞉fo꞉ wa꞉l a꞉na dila꞉la꞉ga꞉ a꞉na iliga꞉fo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ donki mala do꞉la꞉fo꞉ wa꞉l a꞉namio꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ iyayo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ Isib hena yaki maiya꞉ki, a꞉na dila꞉sa꞉ga꞉ iliga꞉fo꞉.
A꞉la꞉dimida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ ene ao iyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ iliga꞉taki a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Gio꞉ toga ha꞉nakiyo꞉, towa꞉yo꞉ kega꞉likiyo꞉ ha꞉na꞉so꞉bo.”
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ao iyo꞉ Isib heno꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Ka꞉ina꞉n hen a꞉namio꞉ iya Ya꞉kobdo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
Iliyo꞉ iyamo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Yosa꞉bo꞉ mo꞉sowo꞉ o꞉sab. Isib heno꞉ tambo e bo꞉fo꞉melea꞉ki, e misa꞉ ta꞉fo꞉lo꞉bo꞉ka꞉!” a꞉la꞉sio꞉. A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Ya꞉koba꞉ ene asulo꞉wo꞉ ko꞉ndo꞉feliaki, eyo꞉ mo꞉tilidabu.

Ko꞉sega Yosa꞉b elo꞉ sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ ao ima꞉yo꞉ iyamo꞉wo꞉ tambo malolo meabiki dabu, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Ya꞉kob e a꞉ma꞉la꞉ Isib mena꞉ki a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kelego꞉ donkiya꞉lo꞉ i fofodo꞉ susululia꞉ ha꞉na꞉sen iliga꞉fo꞉ a꞉no꞉ eyo꞉ ba꞉dakiyo꞉, asulo꞉ elo꞉wo꞉ o꞉li a꞉dowo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Isolael eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “A꞉no꞉ o꞉li. O꞉go꞉ ni so꞉wa Yosa꞉bo꞉ o꞉sab a꞉la꞉tiliasulo꞉l ko꞉lo꞉, ne o꞉soma꞉ni ilikiyo꞉, na꞉ so꞉wa ko꞉le ba꞉ba꞉ni ha꞉na꞉nigo꞉l.”
